Name: awakening_line_IDLE_DROP
Text: Identity stabilized… Deploying subject to live conflict zone. Welcome to Neon Core.

Name: awakening_line_DROP_PATROL
Text: Hostiles on your position. Move and shoot.

Name: awakening_line_PATROL_ESCALATION
Text: Something bigger is coming. Use cover.

Name: awakening_alert_alert_PATROL_ESCALATION
Text: NEON CORE DISTRICT ALERT: Faction activity detected

Name: awakening_line_ESCALATION_LOOT
Text: Gear recovered. Everything you do improves your build.

Name: awakening_line_LOOT_CAPTURE
Text: Capture point marked. Secure it.

Name: awakening_line_CAPTURE_HOLD
Text: Hold position. New wave incoming.

Name: awakening_line_HOLD_EXTRACT
Text: Point held. Extraction route unlocked.

Name: awakening_line_EXTRACT_COMPLETE
Text: Sector stabilized. Returning to command interface.

Name: broken-signal_nova_IDLE_TRIGGERED
Text: That wasn't supposed to happen… something is interfering with the ad network.

Name: broken-signal_nova_TRIGGERED_DISCOVERY
Text: Follow that signal. It's moving toward the industrial zone.

Name: broken-signal_nova_DISCOVERY_TRAVERSAL
Text: We're entering a corrupted sector. Stay alert.

Name: broken-signal_nova_TRAVERSAL_COMBAT_1
Text: These drones are scanning for corrupted data… take them out.

Name: broken-signal_nova_COMBAT_1_HACKING
Text: Stabilize the data stream. Think of it like routing clean data through broken systems.

Name: broken-signal_nova_HACKING_COMBAT_2
Text: They've noticed you. Incoming wave.

Name: broken-signal_nova_COMBAT_2_HACKING
Text: Wave down. Finish the route.

Name: broken-signal_nova_HACKING_COMPLETE
Text: Signal traced… it's coming from deeper in the system. We're not alone in here.

Name: broken-signal_nova_COMPLETE_WORLD_UPDATE
Text: The wall's open. Undercore subway is live — and the city's signage is still glitching.

Name: drowned-relay_nova_IDLE_TRIGGERED
Text: The relay you fixed pointed past the treeline. I followed it into the swamp and lost it in the fog. Something out there is soaking up the signal.

Name: drowned-relay_nova_TRIGGERED_WADING
Text: Got it. An old Vanguard relay mast, half sunk. The swamp grew over it and it's still drawing power. Watch the reeds on the way in.

Name: drowned-relay_nova_WADING_COMBAT_1
Text: Contact, all around you. The spore-walkers nest on the relay's power. Hold your ground.

Name: drowned-relay_nova_COMBAT_1_PURGING
Text: They're down. The relay's channels are choked with spore-mass. Match each channel to the carrier pulse and burn it clean.

Name: drowned-relay_nova_PURGING_BOSS
Text: Channels are clear, and something under the water just lost its food. That's what was watching you. Kraken-Vanguard, incoming.

Name: drowned-relay_nova_BOSS_COMPLETE
Text: It's down. It used to be a Vanguard war-frame before the swamp took it. The relay's transmitting clean now.

Name: drowned-relay_nova_COMPLETE_WORLD_UPDATE
Text: The signal didn't start here. The relay was only passing it along, straight to Neon City. Whoever is sending it is in there.

Name: blackout-protocol_nova_IDLE_TRIGGERED
Text: That trace didn't dead-end — it led straight into Neon City's own grid. Somebody's hiding behind the Syndicate's noise.

Name: blackout-protocol_nova_TRIGGERED_INFILTRATION
Text: Get into the district. Keep your profile low until we're past their first scanners.

Name: blackout-protocol_nova_INFILTRATION_COMBAT_1
Text: Substation's guarded. Clear them before anyone calls it in.

Name: blackout-protocol_nova_COMBAT_1_HACKING
Text: Three relays feed the surveillance net. Cut them in sequence, or it just reroutes around you.

Name: blackout-protocol_nova_HACKING_COMBAT_2
Text: Grid noticed the cut. Enforcer wave inbound — hold the relay.

Name: blackout-protocol_nova_COMBAT_2_HACKING
Text: Wave down. Finish the cut.

Name: blackout-protocol_nova_HACKING_COMPLETE
Text: Grid's down. Whole district just went dark — and under all that dead signal, something else just lit up.

Name: blackout-protocol_nova_COMPLETE_WORLD_UPDATE
Text: They're calling whatever's underneath the Stitched Neon Core. That's not on any map NOVA has.

Name: stitched-neon-core_nova_IDLE_TRIGGERED
Text: That dead grid under the blackout isn't dead — it's stitched into something older. NOVA's got a fix on it. Go.

Name: stitched-neon-core_nova_TRIGGERED_DESCENT
Text: Access point's below the substation. Whatever's down there has been running quiet for a long time — don't wake it early.

Name: stitched-neon-core_nova_DESCENT_COMBAT_1
Text: You're in the chamber. Defense grid's active — clear it before it locks the room down.

Name: stitched-neon-core_nova_COMBAT_1_STABILIZING
Text: Three resonance nodes are keeping this thing fused in place. Stabilize all three or it destabilizes the whole chamber.

Name: stitched-neon-core_nova_STABILIZING_BOSS
Text: Nodes are stable — and that just woke it up. Aegis-Prime, fully online. Fight.

Name: stitched-neon-core_nova_BOSS_COMPLETE
Text: Aegis-Prime's down. The core's exposed — and it's still transmitting.

Name: stitched-neon-core_nova_COMPLETE_WORLD_UPDATE
Text: That signal wasn't coming from Neon City. It was coming through it — from somewhere under Thalassia.

Name: solar-array_nova_IDLE_TRIGGERED
Text: Neon's grid doesn't make its own power. It's beamed in from the desert. Let's find out who's holding the other end.

Name: solar-array_nova_TRIGGERED_CROSSING
Text: Solar Array Alpha, out on the Glass Flats. Keep moving out there. The heat will cook you if you stand still.

Name: solar-array_nova_CROSSING_COMBAT_1
Text: Raiders dug in around the mirrors. They're stripping it for parts. Clear them out.

Name: solar-array_nova_COMBAT_1_REALIGNING
Text: The mirrors have drifted, so all that heat is pooling at the focal point. Turn each one back onto the collector.

Name: solar-array_nova_REALIGNING_BOSS
Text: Beam's back on the collector, and something at the focal point just lost its meal. The anomaly's hardening. Hit it only when the light cracks across its shell.

Name: solar-array_nova_BOSS_COMPLETE
Text: It shattered. The array's running clean for the first time in years.

Name: solar-array_nova_COMPLETE_WORLD_UPDATE
Text: I traced the beam. It doesn't stop at Neon. It runs straight into Nexus City, into the Authority's Core Node. They've been powering the whole war from out here.

Name: core-node_nova_IDLE_TRIGGERED
Text: The beam from Solara ends in Nexus City, at the Authority's Core Node. Everything we've chased runs through that building.

Name: core-node_nova_TRIGGERED_INFILTRATE
Text: Core Node's at the center of the grid. The Authority will see us coming. That's fine. We just need to get there first.

Name: core-node_nova_INFILTRATE_COMBAT_1
Text: Response team inbound. Hold the node while I find the archive.

Name: core-node_nova_COMBAT_1_HACKING
Text: They're down. The archive wants a handshake. Repeat the pattern and I'll do the rest.

Name: core-node_nova_HACKING_REVEAL
Text: I'm in. Before you read this, there's something I have to tell you.

Name: core-node_nova_REVEAL_COMPLETE_controllers
Text: The Controllers, then. Fine. If locking it down is what keeps people alive, I'll help you hold the key steady.

Name: core-node_nova_REVEAL_COMPLETE_breakers
Text: The Breakers. You want it all to break open. I can't say I'm not afraid of that. I'll still take you there.

Name: core-node_nova_REVEAL_COMPLETE_resonants
Text: The Resonants. Thank you. I think that's what I was hoping you'd say, and I didn't dare ask.

Name: core-node_nova_COMPLETE_WORLD_UPDATE
Text: The Authority will lock Nexus down over this. Let them. We know where the Core is now, and they don't know what we chose.

Name: frozen-beacon_nova_IDLE_TRIGGERED
Text: That purge in Nexus didn't start in Nexus. The order was relayed in from the north, from the Frostspire passes.

Name: frozen-beacon_nova_TRIGGERED_TRAVEL
Text: There's a relay beacon up on the high pass, iced over but still live. Keep moving. The cold here gets into your head.

Name: frozen-beacon_nova_TRAVEL_COMBAT_1
Text: Guards, frozen into position until something walked in. That's you. Clear them.

Name: frozen-beacon_nova_COMBAT_1_HACKING
Text: The beacon's key is scrambled. I'll show you the pattern; you put it back in the right order.

Name: frozen-beacon_nova_HACKING_BOSS
Text: Re-keying it cracked the ice around something big. That's Subject Zero, the Authority's first Resonant experiment. They froze it up here to guard this.

Name: frozen-beacon_nova_BOSS_COMPLETE
Text: Subject Zero's down. The beacon's open, and it still has the purge order in its buffer.

Name: frozen-beacon_nova_COMPLETE_WORLD_UPDATE
Text: The order wasn't the Authority's. It came up from Ember Peaks, from the reactor where containment failed the first time.

Name: failure-core_nova_IDLE_TRIGGERED
Text: The purge order traced back here, to the reactor in the caldera. Something down there is still giving orders.

Name: failure-core_nova_TRIGGERED_TRAVEL
Text: The reactor's still running, and it's way past safe. Get to the control ring before it spikes again.

Name: failure-core_nova_TRAVEL_COMBAT_1
Text: Guard drones, still on the original containment protocol. They think you're the breach.

Name: failure-core_nova_COMBAT_1_HACKING
Text: Pressure's climbing. Set each vent valve to what the core can hold, or this whole caldera goes.

Name: failure-core_nova_HACKING_BOSS
Text: Venting it woke the operator. Overseer Kael. He's been down here since the first failure, trying to restart containment.

Name: failure-core_nova_BOSS_COMPLETE
Text: Kael's down. Reactor's stable. And its logs are open.

Name: failure-core_nova_COMPLETE_WORLD_UPDATE
Text: It was never containing the Fracture. It was feeding it. And the fuel came in by convoy, up the Grid-Iron Highway.

Name: convoy-breaker_nova_IDLE_TRIGGERED
Text: The reactor's fuel came in by convoy. There's one running the Grid-Iron Highway right now.

Name: convoy-breaker_nova_TRIGGERED_TRAVEL
Text: Convoy's stopped at a junction on the highway. That's your window.

Name: convoy-breaker_nova_TRAVEL_COMBAT_1
Text: Rebellion escorts, running stolen Fracture tech. They're not going to let you near those tankers.

Name: convoy-breaker_nova_COMBAT_1_HACKING
Text: The tankers are on an override lock. Match each lock's code to its signature and they're ours.

Name: convoy-breaker_nova_HACKING_BOSS
Text: The override was keyed to someone. The Rust-King Gant, and he wants his convoy back.

Name: convoy-breaker_nova_BOSS_COMPLETE
Text: Gant's down. The manifests are open.

Name: convoy-breaker_nova_COMPLETE_WORLD_UPDATE
Text: Every tanker was going to one buyer. Not the Rebellion, not the Authority. The Fuel King.

Name: descent-protocol_nova_IDLE_TRIGGERED
Text: I traced it as far as I can over the grid. Past that it's open ocean, and then it's gone dark — straight down. Whatever's under there has been quiet a very long time.

Name: descent-protocol_nova_TRIGGERED_DIVE
Text: That's not seabed out there. That's architecture — and a docking ring still blinking. Take us to the Sentry Dock. Hull's going to complain on the way down.

Name: descent-protocol_nova_DIVE_COMBAT_1
Text: We're through the outer seal and the dock's security frames just woke up. Clear them — then we can get that airlock breathing again.

Name: descent-protocol_nova_COMBAT_1_AIRLOCK
Text: Dock's quiet. The airlock controller is fried but not dead — reroute it and the dock air station comes back with it.

Name: descent-protocol_nova_AIRLOCK_RING
Text: Airlock's holding and the station's pumping air — that's our checkpoint. Next is the Abyssal Ring. The floor's flooded with live coolant: when it charges, get up off the floor.

Name: descent-protocol_nova_RING_CORE
Text: You made the far side. Below us is the Sunk-Core — the rupture. Past crush depth your suit starts to give, so go down, get the reactor, come back up.

Name: descent-protocol_nova_CORE_TRACING
Text: That's the reactor — or what's left of it. Something's feeding it from the rift below. Trace the signal before the patrols close in.

Name: descent-protocol_nova_TRACING_COMPLETE
Text: There. That's it — the Deepmind's control core. Whatever the Fracture actually is, it started right there. And it just noticed you.

Name: descent-protocol_nova_COMPLETE_WORLD_UPDATE
Text: It's not responding to the trace anymore. It's responding to you. Next time we go down there, we're not finding it by accident.

Name: system-core_nova_IDLE_TRIGGERED
Text: Every world you've touched — Veridan, Neon City, the Wastelands, all of it — routes back to the same place. Thalassia's core isn't a ruin anymore. It's awake, and it's been waiting for you.

Name: system-core_nova_TRIGGERED_DIVE
Text: That's not architecture down there anymore — it's a nervous system, and it's lit up end to end. Go straight to the center.

Name: system-core_nova_DIVE_COMBAT_1
Text: You're at the heart of the Deepmind. It already knows you're inside its perimeter — everything down here is about to answer to it.

Name: system-core_nova_COMBAT_1_STABILIZING
Text: Perimeter's down. It's not hiding anymore — three containment locks are all that's keeping its real core sealed off. Break them and it has nowhere left to retreat.

Name: system-core_nova_STABILIZING_BOSS
Text: Locks are down. The System Core — the thing every Fracture Architect, every world, every one of them, has been answering to — just opened its eyes.

Name: system-core_nova_BOSS_COMPLETE
Text: The System Core is down. Whatever the Fracture actually was, it just lost whatever was holding it together.

Name: system-core_nova_COMPLETE_WORLD_UPDATE
Text: It's quiet down here now. Really quiet, for the first time since any of this started. I think that's it. I think it's over.
